description:
Halloran has a parcel in a drop near the Hall of Records and wants it brought to him. It's sealed. He won't say what's in it, and when you ask he tells you why not.

"If they pick you up, you can only tell them what you know. So we make sure that's almost nothing. You know me and you know this bench. That's two people and one room, and it's as much as anybody down here knows about anybody."

He goes back to work.

"Don't open it, don't ask about it, and don't carry it like it matters. Somebody who looks like they're carrying something is the only kind of person anybody stops."
name: Proof of Hands

objectives.desc: Collect the sealed parcel from the drop near the Hall of Records.
emotes: {who} eases the parcel out from behind the brick and puts it under an arm.
{who} doesn't weigh it in their hand, and is aware of not doing it.
{who} walks back without hurrying and without stopping.

objectives.desc: Take it back to Halloran at the bench.
emotes: {who} puts it on the bench still sealed.
{who} watches him not look at it either.
